Commentary.Commentary: We're back! The English team is in a huddle. KL Rahul and Ishan Kishan are the Indian openers for this match. David Willey is ready to bowl the first over...
... RUN CHASE ...

Right then. India need 189 to win and will need all their batters to contribute well if they want to chase this down. They do have the firepower required but it will not be easy against this talented English bowling attack. It should be a close chase. Stay tuned for India's reply.

The Indians did not have the best time out in the middle and will feel like they have conceded around 20-25 runs more than what they would have wanted. They did well in the middle phase as their spinners made batting slightly tough for the English batters but that did not continue for long as the Brits bounced back well towards the end. As usual, Jasprit Bumrah continued to be the star for India as he finished with figures of 4-0-26-1, bowling two top overs at the death. Ravichandran Ashwin had a fruitful evening, as he conceded just 23 in his quota of 4 overs. Mohammed Shami and Rahul Chahar had wickets to their names, as the former had 3, and Rahul had one, but they were slightly expensive. Bhuvneshwar Kumar went wicketless and did not look like he was at his best.

This has been a good batting display by England and they will be pretty pleased that they have breached the 180-run mark. Most of their batters contributed decently but Liam Livingstone and Jonny Bairstow took the charge in the middle overs, which helped them end on a competitive total. Inside the Powerplay, the English Lions lost both their openers as they could not continue after getting decent starts. Malan was looking like he was settling in well but Chahar got the better of him. A 52-run stand was created between Livingstone and Bairstow but as they were looking to amp it up, Liam fell. Bairstow continued on his way and just missed out on his fifty, as he lost his wicket on 49. Moeen Ali gave him company and slammed a few lusty blows towards the end as he ended with a 20-ball 43, which saw them end on 188.

SIX! Moeen ends the innings with a mighty hit! Bhuvneshwar Kumar misses the line and length, delivers it full and around off, right in the arc for Moeen and he launches it over long off. 21 from the last over and England finish on 188/5.
SIX! A low full toss outside off, Moeen once again goes after it and slices it over backward point for a biggie.
FOUR! Streaky! Fuller and wide outside off, Moeen throws his bat at it and edges it past the diving keeper for a boundary at third man.
Yorker around middle, Moeen digs it out on the leg side and it dribbles through mid-wicket. They collect another two.

Once again Moeen reaches out for delivery wide outside off and this time he connects. He sends it from the toe end of his bat to deep cover. Virat Kohli runs across to his right but the ball lands and spins away. He does well to stop it with his left hand and avoids an embarrassing situation. Two taken.
Identical to the last delivery, this time it's just inside the tramline, Moeen chases but misses.
Wide! Kumar fails to get his line right on the first ball, delivers it way wide outside off, Moeen leaves it.
Shortish and around off, Woakes shapes up for a pull shot but it takes the bottom edge and goes on one bounce to Pant. A dot ball. End of a top over from Jasprit Bumrah!
Bhuvneshwar Kumar to end proceedings in this innings. 0/33 in his 3 overs. Can he bowl a stingy over?
Very full and around leg, Moeen is beaten for pace and hence fails to flick it away. The ball deflects off his pads to point and they steal a leg bye.
Moeen plays it straight and bags a couple. Bumrah delivers it in the blockhole, Ali digs it out back past the bowler and comes back for the second run.
Fuller and outside off, pushed away to point for a single.
Chris Woakes makes his way out into the middle.

OUT! TIMBER! That's an absolute jaffa from Jasprit Bumrah. An unplayable leg-stump yorker, landing right on the popping crease, Jonny Bairstow tries to keep it out but misses and finds the stumps disturbed. Great delivery to remove a set batsman from the crease. A handy knock nonetheless from Jonny.
Yorker around off, slower in pace, Jonny Bairstow pushes it through point and collects a couple of runs.
Jasprit Bumrah will bowl the penultimate over. He has given 21 off his previous 3 overs. Can he end things well?
Full toss on middle, Jonny hangs back and lofts it over mid on for a run. 12 from this over as well, 24 in the last two.
Too full and on off, much better from Shami this time, Moeen squeezes it out to deep point for a single.
FOUR! Even better from Ali. Slower one, full and outside off, Moeen attacks the room and smashes it through extra cover for a boundary.
FOUR! Great shot by Mo! Very full and a touch straighter at the stumps, right in the arc for the batsman, Moeen clears his front leg an drills it down the ground for a boundary at long off.

Direct hit would have been curtains for Moeen Ali. On a length and around off, Moeen punches it to extra cover and rushes across to the other end. Virat Kohli has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. They cross for an overthrow. 150 up!
Play and a miss! Shami runs in from 'round the wicket and delivers it very full and wide outside off, Moeen tries to dig it out but misses.
A wide yorker outside off, Jonny forces it down through wide mid off and collects a couple of runs. 12 from this over!
Kumar bowls a low full toss on middle, Ali tickles it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Shot! Moeen loves to play inside-out. A delivery landing on a length around off and angling away, Ali holds his pose inside the crease and smacks it over extra cover.
In the blockhole, Moeen digs it out back to the bowler.

Two wides! Attempted slower one, short and way wide outside off, Jonny Bairstow chases but misses. Rishabh Pant gets a bad bounce and fails to collect it cleanly. The short third man fielder cuts it off and the batters cross.
On a length and wide outside off, slower in pace, Moeen stays back and slaps it to long off for a run.

Up and over the infield! Fuller in length and wide outside off, Moeen goes for the drive away from his body but it takes the toe end of the bat and flies over the leaping extra cover fielder. The sweeper in the deep sweeps it off and the batters take two.
Short and wide outside off, slower in pace, Bairstow cuts but finds backward point. Either side of that fielder and it would have been a boundary. End of a good over from Bumrah, 7 from it.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar returns. 2-0-21-0 are his figures until now.
Jasprit Bumrah bowls this from wide of the crease, a full toss on middle, angling down, Jonny Bairstow tries to flick but misses. The bowler appeals a bit before going to collect the ball.

FOUR! Superb shot! Very full and outside off, Jonny Bairstow leans into the drive and caresses it square of the wicket on the off side. There is a sweeper cover in place but it's too far away from him to cut off. Brilliant timing and placement.
Fuller again, around off, Jonny goes for another flick shot and it goes off the toe end. The ball dribbles to the right of long on and they take two.
Fullish and in the line of the stumps, Jonny Bairstow tries to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Slower one, a touch short around middle and off, Moeen plays it down from the crease to the off side. The ball rolls to covers and they cross.
Jasprit Bumrah is back on. 0/14 in his two overs so far.
Mo starts with a run! Fuller, on off, jammed out through mid off for one.
Moeen Ali arrives.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! What a way to respond from Shami. He has a knack of getting back at batters when things are going their way. He serves a perfect yorker, around off and middle, right in the blockhole, Liam Livingstone tries his best to dig this one out but it does not prove to be enough. The wickets behind are disturbed as the ball deflects off the pads. A good stand for the English Lions perishes.
Around off, hooked away to the deep mid-wicket region for a run.
SIX! Stand and deliver! A biggie to bring up the 50-run stand between these two! In the slot around off, Jonny Bairstow stands tall and effortlessly smokes this one over long on.
WIDE. Short and down the leg side, again, JB misses his pull. Pant does well to dive to his left and stop the ball.
Full on middle, Liam heaves this to deep mid-wicket for one.
TWO WIDES! On a length, sliding down the leg side, the pull is missed and Pant fumbles too as the batters sneak a run.
A full toss, around off, hit to the cover fielder.
Just a run! On middle, fuller, hit hard, but to the fielder at long on for one. Rahul Chahar ends a slightly expensive outing, ending with figures of 4-0-43-1.
Bowling change. Mohammed Shami is back on, 2/16 in his 2 overs so far.
NO BALL! On middle, dragged to deep mid-wicket for one. Rahul has overstepped and a no ball has been called. Free Hit for Jonny!
FOUR! Third boundary of the over and Liam Livingstone is amping it up! Fuller, around off, Liam Livingstone gives the full punch of the blade and whacks it through covers for a boundary.
Full, on off, LL looks to drive but gets the outside edge to short third man.

FOUR! Another boundary and Chahar is getting the treatment from Livingstone! Flatter, around middle and leg, easy work for Liam as he swivels and pumps this one towards deep square leg. It takes a bounce and goes past the ropes, but the umpire signals it as a biggie. One replay and the decision is changed to a four.
Some turn on this! Flatter, around middle, the ball lands and spins away as Liam misses his poke.
SIX! Straight as an arrow! Well connected. This is bowled fuller, tossed up, around off, Liam Livingstone clears his front leg and thumps this one over Chahar for a biggie.
Will Rahul Chahar also bowl out? Yup, the leggie is ready to bowl his fourth over.

'HOWZAT?' screams Pant, but the umpire is not interested. Fuller, a carrom ball landing around off and spinning away, Jonny Bairstow presses forward and swings his bat but misses. Pant collects and whips the bails off but JB looks to have never left the crease. An excited appeal from Rishabh but the umpire does not flinch.
Tries to be funky again, does Jonny, but it does not work out! Fuller now, outside off, Jonny Bairstow looks for the reverse-hit again but does not connect.
On middle, LL works this through mid on for one more.
A single as this is punched down to long on. 100 up!
FOUR! Funky! Slightly shorter, outside off, Jonny Bairstow gets low, reverse-hits this past the short third man fielder and bags a boundary.
Fuller, on middle, Jonny Bairstow gets low and drags this in between deep square leg and deep mid-wicket. A couple of runs.
Will Ravichandran Ashwin bowl out? The answer is yes.
Around off, pushed back to the bowler. A decent over for England after a while, 12 from it.
FOUR! Liam Livingstone is finding the boundaries now! A drag down, short and sliding down the leg side, Liam Livingstone gets inside the line and pulls it behind square on the leg side. Boundary.
On middle, worked to the leg side for a run.
Pushed through covers for a run.
FOUR! Connects with it this time! Fuller, wider outside off, Liam Livingstone gets underneath this and smacks this over covers for a boundary.

In the air...safe! Liam Livingstone lives to die another day. It lands in between three men. Fuller, around off, Liam Livingstone wants to slam this one over the off side but slices this over extra cover. Three men charge towards it but it lands in front of the long off fielder, who was running across to his left from long off. Two taken.
Just 2 off this over. India are doing well in the middle overs, the spinners, actually. Around off, cut away, but straight to the backward point fielder.

Edged....just short! Flatter, quicker, landing around middle and off, Jonny Bairstow wants to flick this to the leg side but closes the face of the bat early. The leading edge is induced and the ball loops back to Ashwin, who gets low, but the ball reaches him on the bounce.
Update - In another warm-up game involving Australia and New Zealand, the latter have reached 93/1 at the end of 10 overs.
Loopy this time, on middle, knocked through mid on for one.
Floated on off, defended back onto the deck.
Quicker and shorter outside off, LL works this to Virat at covers.
Shortish and outside off, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for one.
3 runs and a wicket off this one, a good over by Chahar! On middle, Jonny goes back and taps this to mid-wicket for one.
Liam Livingstone opens his account by pushing this fuller delivery down to long off.
Around off, pushed to the fielder at covers.
Starts with a fuller delivery, wider outside off to Liam, he looks to hit it to the off side but misses.

Drinks break. Time for a breather. India have done well so far to keep things under control. Three wickets are already in the bag and they will be hoping to keep picking wickets and not allow England any kind of momentum heading into the death overs. Liam Livingstone joins Jonny Bairstow in the middle.

OUT! TIMBER! A smile on Chahar's face and England lose their third. Rahul outfoxes Malan and the southpaw goes back for an 18-ball 18. Chahar serves a flighted googly, around leg and turning away, Dawid Malan makes room by shuffling to the leg side and thinks about lofting this one over the cover region. His thought was a good one, but the execution was not. He misses and the ball strikes the top of the off pole.
Quicker, flatter, around middle and leg, JB flicks this to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Well bowled by Ash! Just 5 off this one. He sees Dawid dancing down and serves it slightly slower and shorter on the body. Dawid is early into the shot and works it back to the bowler.
Slower through the air, fuller, around off, pushed away to Kohli at covers.
On middle, Jonny works this in front of square leg for a single.
Slightly fuller, around off, Malan lines up to play the slog-sweep but only manages an inside edge, on the pads, to the off side, for a quick single.
Served shorter and on middle, from 'round the wicket, punched through mid on for one.
Ashwin serves this flatter and on the pads, this is worked behind square on the leg side and a couple of runs are bagged.
12 off this one! Full on off, milked down to long on for one.
On middle and leg, Dawid Malan gets low and sweeps this to deep square leg for one.
Better from Rahul. Flatter, around off, JB knocks this down to the on side for one.

FOUR! More control on this shot and another boundary is bagged. Some width offered outside off, floated again, Jonny Bairstow plays the inside-out shot beautifully over covers. One bounce and a boundary.

FOUR! Not the cleanest of shots but Jonny still finds the fence. Fuller, tossed up nicely, landing around off, Jonny Bairstow hits this off the lower end of the blade over Chahar and wide of the long off fielder for a boundary.
Leg bye. Chahar begins with a fuller delivery, on the pads. Malan misses his tuck and the ball takes the pad and goes behind square leg, for a leg bye.
Change in bowling. Rahul Chahar to bowl his leggies.
A single to end Ash's first over as Malan chips this over mid off and takes one. 8 off Ashwin's first over!
FOUR! Very well played. A top shot. Fuller this time, floated, around off, Dawid Malan makes room and lofts this one over covers for a one-bounce boundary.
Ash does well this time. He sees Malan skipping down the deck and serves a quicker and flatter ball on middle, Dawid only pushes this to the leg side.
Another run as this shorter ball is eased down the ground towards long on.
Shorter and quicker around off, Dawid Malan goes back and punches this past the point fielder for one.
Ash starts with a flatter ball on the pads, Jonny works it nice and fine towards deep square leg for a single.
Ravichandran Ashwin to bowl now.
Back of a length, around off, Jonny Bairstow stays back and plays it in the vacant area at point for one. 51/2 at the end of the Powerplay!
Jonny Bairstow opens his account with a couple of runs. A touch short and around off, Jonny steers it wide of short third man for two. 50 up!
Fuller and on middle, Jonny Bairstow flicks it towards mid-wicket. A bit of a misfield from Virat Kohli but no run is conceded.
Wide! Shami tries to buy another wicket by bowling down the leg side, this time Jonny misses his flick and it's been wided.

OUT! CAUGHT! Shami gets his second wicket and he has now dismissed both the English openers. Honestly, this one was not a wicket-taking delivery. It's served on a length around middle and leg, there to be hit but Jason Roy miscues his attempted flick off the pads and sends it aerially to short fine leg. Jasprit Bumrah is alert there and takes the catch safely.
Commentary.Howout: c Jasprit Bumrah b Mohammed Shami

Commentary.Commentary: Jonny Bairstow is the new batter in.
Shami comes from 'round the wicket and angles in a length ball on off, Dawid stays back and guides it to third man for a single.
Shortish and around leg, Roy steps back and works it off the inner half. It goes past the square leg umpire who does well to make way and the batters take one.
Change of gloves for Jason Roy now.
Back of a length on off, Malan stands back and plays it down to short third man.

FOUR! Connects and connects well this time. On a length around off, slower in pace, Malan picks it and plays his shot a bit late. He leans and uses his beautiful hands to thump it through the gap at covers for a boundary.
Beaten all ends up! Full and fiery, outside off and angling away, Malan decides to play a booming cover drive but misses.
LUCKY FOUR! Jasprit Bumrah dishes out a terrific yorker, around off, Malan digs it out from the outer half of his bat and the ball scoots through the gap between Pant and first slip for a boundary.
Play and a miss! Fuller this time, landing around off and angling away, Malan tries to heave it over the leg side but misses.
Bumrah begins with a low dipping full toss on off, Malan pushes it out to short cover.
Shami has bowled much better in the second half of his over. Delivers this one outside off, on a length and this one stays low, Roy pushes at it and misses.
Malan opens his account with his pet shot. Shortish and around off, Dawid stays back and runs it down towards third man for a run.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! There is the retort from the bowler. Shami will be happy now after getting his revenge. Perhaps the slower one, on a length around off, Buttler decides to play late and guide it towards third man. But he is early into the shot and the ball beats his bat before disturbing the stumps.
In walks Dawid Malan!
Wide! Shami tries following the batsman down the leg side, short in length, Buttler attempts to pull but misses.
FOUR! Boom! Full and on middle, right in the slot, Buttler shows the full face of the bat and whacks it straight down the ground.
Full and around off, pushed to covers.
FOUR! Jos Buttler copies the last shot from Roy and fetches a boundary for himself. The line is too straight and Buttler walks across to tickle it wide of short fine leg.
FOUR! A touch short and around off, Jason Roy shuffles across the stumps and nicely puts it away behind short fine leg for a boundary.
Change. Mohammed Shami is introduced into the attack!

A muted appeal for an lbw! On a length around middle and leg, angling down, Roy tries to work it on the leg side but misses. He is rapped on the pads but nothing from the umpire after the Indians appealed.

Mix-up but safe! Back of a length, around middle and leg, Roy steps back and plays it down to extra cover. Buttler looks to respond for a run but is sent back. He would have been a goner had Kohli scored a direct hit at the bowler's end.
Well bowled. A near-yorker around leg, Buttler clears his front leg and digs it out down to long on. A single is taken.
Close to off, on a length, this time Roy stays back and taps it down to cover-point for one. Called a no ball for overstepping. Free Hit to Jos Buttler.
On a length and around off, once again Jason uses his feet to make room and forces it through point for a couple.
FOUR! There you go, Jason Roy uses his feet and dismisses it. Fuller and around middle, Roy dances down the track and lofts it over mid on for a boundary, first from his bat.
Slower one, full and around off, Roy pushes it away towards cover-point for a run.
Jasprit Bumrah looks to surprise the batsman with a yorker but ends up serving a full toss on middle, Buttler tucks it through square leg and takes one.
Pitches it up and around off, Jos Buttler drives it down the ground but not from the middle of his bat. It rolls away to mid on.
On a good length and around off, Roy goes back and pushes it down to the left of mid on for a single.
Fuller and around off, angling in, not much swing there, Jason flicks but picks out the mid-wicket fielder.
The second over also begins with three runs. Jasprit Bumrah starts by spearing in a full ball on middle, Buttler flicks it past the mid-wicket fielder and takes three.
Fractionally short and outside off, Buttler hangs on the back foot and steers it through point for a single.
Who bowls from the other end? It is Jasprit Bumrah!
On a length around off, Buttler covers the line and pushes it past the bowler to mid off.
FOUR! Buttler is away with a boundary. Full and outside off, Jos has to reach out a bit but does well to middle his shot. He places it in the gap at covers and opens his account in style.
A touch short again, around off, Buttler plays it down from the back foot to point. Suryakumar Yadav is present there.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar pulls his length back slightly and lands it around off, Jos Buttler stays back and plays it down near the pitch.
Starts with a fuller delivery, on middle and leg, Jason Roy clips it in the gap at square leg. A big gap is there and England are underway with three runs.

Right. We are ready to get underway here. The Indian players have made their way out and have spread out too. Jason Roy and Jos Buttler will open the innings for England. Bhuvneshwar Kumar to begin with the ball. Here we go...
England - Jason Roy, Jos Buttler (C/WK), Dawid Malan, Jonny Bairstow, Moeen Ali, Liam Livingstone, Chris Woakes, Chris Jordan, Adil Rashid, Mark Wood, David Willey.

India - KL Rahul, Ishan Kishan, Virat Kohli (C), Suryakumar Yadav, Hardik Pandya, Rishabh Pant (WK), Ravindra Jadeja, Shardul Thakur, Ravichandran Ashwin, Jasprit Bumrah, Mohammed Shami, Rahul Chahar, Bhuvneshwar Kumar.
PITCH REPORT - Deep Dasgupta and Dale Steyn are down for the pitch report. Dale says that it might skid on slightly more than during the first game. Adds that the wicket is getting better to bat on.

Jos Buttler, the England skipper, says that everybody is excited and they want to get the campaign underway. Says that Morgan is having a bit of a rest, so it gives another player a chance to get some exposure. Feels that India will come hard at them and there will be some intensity but it is good to be back together as a group. Shares that there is competitiveness in the group and all of them are fighting to play.

The Indian captain, Virat Kohli says they will bowl first. They have had success in the past he adds. Goes on to say the boys want to create the same energy. Mentions they will be keen to give game-time to all the players. Says, after the Indian T20 League season, it is difficult to keep KL Rahul out of the opening spot. Ends by saying that he will bat at number three in this tournament.
It's TOSS time! India have won the flip of the coin and they will FIELD first!

You look at the squads of both India and England and you will find plenty of superstars of the game, individuals who have won games on their own and can set the stage on fire. So forget it's a warm-up game, expect them to fight with the same intensity as they do usually in an international game and gain that winning momentum and confidence heading forward.

Welcome to everyone for this warm-up game! Usually, these practice games don't draw much attention but since India are involved, expect this warm-up game to have plenty of eyeballs. It's not only about India though as England too would be drawing the attention after their triumph in the 50-over World Cup. These two teams are considered to be the favourites in this edition of the ICC Men's T20 World Cup and this game would give us a fair idea about where they stand as a team, in terms of balance, composition and most importantly, acclimatizing to the conditions. Stay tuned for more updates...
... WARM-UP TIME ...
